posts.title: How to Build a Trade Platform on Shopify Grow (Without Shopify B2B)
posts.description: A guide to implementing a trade program for interior designers, architects, and other trade professionals using Shopify Grow and theme-native Liquid — no Shopify Plus B2B required.

posts.title: Shopify Sections Rendering API: Dynamic Updates Without Page Reloads
posts.description: Shopify’s Sections Rendering API allows you to dynamically update parts of a page (like a cart drawer, product grid, or promotional banner) without a full page reload. This improves performance and creates a smoother user experience.
